summary: TSharpVision 1.3.0 is the Unicode text release with cluster-aware rendering and editing, multi-level Undo/Redo, and the offline Unicode character browser.
changes: Unicode 16.0 grapheme-cluster layout and driver text capabilities.
Multi-level Undo/Redo, Select All, strict save encodings and explicit mixed line-ending choices.
Offline TVDemo Unicode browser; SDL GPU startup fallback and cross-platform Windows host metadata classification.
Canonical Unicode and Borland provenance notices shipped with all twelve packages.
compatibility: Preserves the 1.2 public API; nine libraries validate against NuGet 1.2.0. LegacyCellWidth restores legacy layout widths. PublicAPI.Unshipped promotion requires owner review.
limitations: macOS/Linux native visual/input and GPU failure-path acceptance require matching-host qualification; local validation is Windows only.
scope: Unicode text, editor and rendering release; see CHANGELOG.md section 1.3.0.
readme_summary: Unicode grapheme layout, multi-level Undo/Redo and an offline Unicode browser, with nine libraries and three command-line tools.
